*F-MPC* ($n$-party secure computation) is part of *Layer 6: Secret Sharing, Threshold Cryptography, MPC* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Canetti et al. *Universally composable two-party and multi-party secure computation*. In 34th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC), pages 494–503, 2002.
- Ben-Or, Goldwasser, and Wigderson. *Completeness theorems for non-cryptographic fault-tolerant distributed computation*. In 20th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC), pages 1–10, 1988.
